top_signals.title: French Buyers Not Ready To Step in Right Now: Kumra
top_signals.summary: Pooja Kumra, head of Europe and UK rates strategy at TD Bank, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." French bond stress intensified as a broad flight from risk and the threat of another round of weekend protests reinforced the country’s status as the weak link in global markets. The premium on French 10-year bonds over Germany surged to the highest since late 2011. (Source: Bloomberg)
